body.en:
A particle moves in a straight line such that its velocity at time \( t \ge 0 \) is given by \( v = 6t - 2t^2 \text{ m/s} \). Initially, the particle is at origin \( s = 0 \).
(a) Find the time when the particle is instantaneously at rest (for \( t > 0 \)).
(b) Calculate the maximum velocity of the particle.
(c) Find the total distance traveled during the first \( 4 \) seconds.

Solution:
(a) Instantaneous rest occurs when \( v = 0 \):
\[ 6t - 2t^2 = 0 \implies 2t(3 - t) = 0 \implies t = 3 \text{ s} \quad (t > 0) \].

(b) Max velocity occurs when acceleration \( a = \frac{dv}{dt} = 0 \):
\[ a = 6 - 4t = 0 \implies t = 1.5 \text{ s} \].
Since \( \frac{d^2v}{dt^2} = -4 < 0 \), this is a maximum.
\( v_{\text{max}} = 6(1.5) - 2(1.5)^2 = 9 - 4.5 = 4.5 \text{ m/s} \).

(c) Displacement function \( s(t) = \int (6t - 2t^2)\,dt = 3t^2 - \frac{2}{3}t^3 \) (since \( s(0) = 0 \)).
The particle changes direction at \( t = 3 \).
At \( t = 3 \): \( s(3) = 3(9) - \frac{2}{3}(27) = 27 - 18 = 9 \text{ m} \).
At \( t = 4 \): \( s(4) = 3(16) - \frac{2}{3}(64) = 48 - 42.67 = 5.33 \text{ m} \).
Distance from \( t = 0 \) to \( t = 3 \): \( |9 - 0| = 9 \text{ m} \).
Distance from \( t = 3 \) to \( t = 4 \): \( |5.33 - 9| = 3.67 \text{ m} \).
Total distance = \( 9 + 3.67 = 12.67 \text{ m} = \frac{38}{3} \text{ m} \).
Answer: (a) \( 3 \text{ s} \), (b) \( 4.5 \text{ m/s} \), (c) \( 12.67 \text{ m} \).

label.en: Worked Example B — Instantaneous Rate of Change & Tangent Line
label.ar: مثال محلول B — معدل التغير اللحظي ومعادلة المماس

body.en:
Let \( f(x) = 3x^3 - x^2 + 4 \). Find the instantaneous rate of change \( f'(6) \).

Step-by-step Solution:
  1. Differentiate term-by-term using the power rule: \( f'(x) = 9x^2 - 2x \).
  2. Substitute \( x = 6 \): \( f'(6) = 9(6)^2 - 2(6) = 324 - 12 = \mathbf{312} \).
body.ar:
لتكن \( f(x) = 3x^3 - x^2 + 4 \). أوجد معدل التغير اللحظي \( f'(6) \).

الحل بالتفصيل:
  1. نشتق حداً بحداّ: \( f'(x) = 9x^2 - 2x \).
  2. نعوض \( x = 6 \): \( f'(6) = 9(6)^2 - 2(6) = \mathbf{312} \).

question.en: [Integration, Areas & Kinematics · Practice 1] If the governing relation for this system is \( g(t) = 3t + 3 \), evaluate \( g(4) \) and find the inverse input \( t \) when \( g(t) = 18 \).
question.ar: [Integration, Areas & Kinematics · تدريب 1] إذا كانت العلاقة الحاكمة هي \( g(t) = 3t + 3 \)، فأوجد \( g(4) \) وكذلك قيمة \( t \) عندما \( g(t) = 18 \).

solution.en: Substitute \( t = 4 \): \( g(4) = 3(4) + 3 = \mathbf{15} \). Setting \( 3t + 3 = 18 \) gives \( 3t = 15 \implies t = \mathbf{5} \).
solution.ar: بالتعويض عن \( t = 4 \): \( g(4) = 3(4) + 3 = \mathbf{15} \). وعندما \( 3t + 3 = 18 \) فإن \( t = \mathbf{5} \).

question.en: [Integration, Areas & Kinematics · Practice 2] If the governing relation for this system is \( g(t) = 4t + 4 \), evaluate \( g(6) \) and find the inverse input \( t \) when \( g(t) = 32 \).
question.ar: [Integration, Areas & Kinematics · تدريب 2] إذا كانت العلاقة الحاكمة هي \( g(t) = 4t + 4 \)، فأوجد \( g(6) \) وكذلك قيمة \( t \) عندما \( g(t) = 32 \).

solution.en: Substitute \( t = 6 \): \( g(6) = 4(6) + 4 = \mathbf{28} \). Setting \( 4t + 4 = 32 \) gives \( 4t = 28 \implies t = \mathbf{7} \).
solution.ar: بالتعويض عن \( t = 6 \): \( g(6) = 4(6) + 4 = \mathbf{28} \). وعندما \( 4t + 4 = 32 \) فإن \( t = \mathbf{7} \).

question.en: [Integration, Areas & Kinematics · Practice 4] If the governing relation for this system is \( g(t) = 6t + 6 \), evaluate \( g(10) \) and find the inverse input \( t \) when \( g(t) = 72 \).

solution.en: Substitute \( t = 10 \): \( g(10) = 6(10) + 6 = \mathbf{66} \). Setting \( 6t + 6 = 72 \) gives \( 6t = 66 \implies t = \mathbf{11} \).
